purpose: Static fixture corpus for reviewing Google OKF-shaped and OpenKB-style knowledge bundles without installing, ingesting, executing, or trusting generated instructions.

formatBoundaries.okf: Treated as a static interchange format for markdown/frontmatter review.
formatBoundaries.openkb: Treated as a possible producer/toolchain whose generated output remains untrusted until separate review.
formatBoundaries.runtimePolicy: No imported bundle may install skills, run scripts, invoke tools, fetch URLs, call providers, write hosted registries, publish marketplace listings, onboard agents, activate payments, or mutate trust/reputation state.

provenanceNotes: Fixture is curated from prior static research notes, not fetched at validation time.
OKF is represented as markdown/frontmatter interchange input only.
